issues.title: CQL ToString(Ratio) emits raw Ratio JSON instead of round-trippable ratio text
evidence: Official CQL 1.5.3 ToString signature includes ToString(argument Ratio) String.
Official ToString representation table defines Ratio as <quantity>:<quantity> and requires round-trippable output.
Translated CQL ToString(ToRatio('10 ''mg'':2 ''mL''')) currently falls through to TRY_CAST(... AS VARCHAR), returning Ratio JSON instead of 10.0 'mg':2.0 'mL'.
resolution: Added Python and C++ RatioToString UDFs that format Ratio JSON as CQL <quantity>:<quantity> text and reject invalid quantity components.
Routed translated CQL ToString(Ratio) and convert Ratio to String through RatioToString.
Rebuilt and refreshed the bundled CQL DuckDB extension.
verification: Native CQL extension SQL tests passed 624 assertions.
Full fhir4ds pytest passed 7154 with 5 skipped.
Serial full conformance passed ViewDefinition 134/134, FHIRPath 935/935, CQL 1706/1706, DQM 47/47, overall 2822/2822.
